title: Setup complete
lead: The administrator account has been created.
created: The administrator account has been created.
heading: Last step: remove the setup token
intro: Sign-in stays blocked while SETUP_TOKEN is set on the server. The token is only needed once.
serverDownTitle: The server is not answering right now.
serverDownDetail: If you are restarting it, reload this page once it is running again.

instructions.removeToken: Delete the SETUP_TOKEN line from the .env file, or leave it empty (SETUP_TOKEN=).
instructions.restart: Restart the server so it reads the change. With Docker Compose, run docker compose up -d; a plain docker compose restart keeps the old value.
instructions.reload: Reload this page. Once the token is gone, it takes you to Hexmark.
